title: Selvage Session Protocol — the members every frame shares
description: Scalars and small objects of `selvage/1`: the wire version, roles, peer records, document paths, request ids. Valid against PROTOCOL.md §4–§6. Every object here tolerates members it does not know (CANONICAL.md §3), so no schema in this directory forbids one.

version.description: The `v` member of every text frame: the wire version of the frame's sender. Required, checked on every frame, and refused at the handshake with `unsupported_version` when incompatible.

requestId.description: A client-assigned request id, unique per connection and never reused for the life of that connection. Bounded at 2^53-1 because a JavaScript receiver cannot hold a larger integer exactly (CANONICAL.md §2.4).

role.description: A claimed or assigned role. Minting a room makes a connection its host whatever it claims (§9).

peerId.description: A server-assigned, opaque, room-unique identifier. It does not survive a reconnect: a reconnecting client is a new peer (§9.1). The reference server mints `p-<16 hex>`.

roomId.description: An opaque room identifier. The reference server mints `r-<12 hex>`. A spec may pin a format later; today a client must treat it as opaque (`NOTES.md` §B.12).

token.description: The invite token: the permission (§9). Carried in the connection URL by a joiner and echoed exactly once, in `room.created`. The reference server mints 32 hex characters.

documentPath.description: A workspace-relative path: non-empty after trimming, and otherwise unvalidated in this slice (`NOTES.md` §B.8). The reference server answers `bad_params` for a blank one, and `doc.open` and `doc.close` carry the same field. Document identity is the path; it is not encoded inside the CRDT.

awarenessClientId.description: A y-protocols awareness client id. Supplied by the client in `session.hello` and echoed on its `PeerInfo`, so an editor adapter can join a cursor to a display name without putting identity into awareness (§8.4).

peer.description: A participant, as the session layer sees one. Identity is the display name and nothing else.

awareness_client_id.description: Omitted when the connection did not claim one.

display_name.description: The only identity in this slice, sent by its owner in `session.hello` and echoed here. At most 32 UTF-16 code units (PROTOCOL.md §5), so an astral character costs two; `maxLength` counts Unicode code points, where an astral character costs one, so an implementation that enforces the protocol's bound counts UTF-16 code units itself. The server answers `bad_params` for a longer name and never truncates one.

documentSet.description: The result of `doc.open` and `doc.close`: the room's open-document set after the change, so a caller is told what its request did instead of assuming it.

documentList.description: A list of document paths, in first-opened order. The room's open-document set and the `documents` member of every event that reports it are the same list.
